liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I've Just Seen the Rock of Ages** (1 other source): Taper singles out this song, quoting a lyric about wanting to blow out your brains [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **Nashville Blues**: rare: 13 archived performances [6]
- **Ground Speed**: back after 154 archived shows (908 days); rare: 7 archived performances [6]
- **Blues Stay Away From Me**: rare: 8 archived performances [6]
- **If Your Hair's Too Long (There's Sin in Your Heart)**: rare: 14 archived performances [6]
- **Born to Be With You**: back after 128 archived shows (808 days); rare: 3 archived performances [6]
- **My Love Comes Rolling Down**: back after 45 archived shows (374 days); rare: 10 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2024-07-30** (recommended): source not stated; 28 songs; 190 min [1]
- **billystrings2024-07-30G-Man2024-07-30**: audience recording; 28 songs; 158 min [2]
- **billystrings2024-07-30.Capt.Greg.FLAC**: audience recording; 28 songs; 155 min [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording with decent room ambiance, but a loose cable caused a few problems [3]
- **billystrings2024-07-30.fernandez**: source not stated; 28 songs; 155 min [4]

## Around the show

- Taper sat in section 102, row L, seat 7, with the mics on a stand about six feet up [1]
- Taper says the second night's recording of the run is flawless, unlike this one [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2024-07-30**: taped by Mark Davidson; transferred by Mark Davidson; source: FOB AKG CK63 (DINA) > Nbob Actives > Baby Nbox > Roland 07 @ 96 kHz 24 bit [1]. Also: Transfer went from WAV through Adobe Audition to FLAC 24/96, with fingerprints made in xACT on 2024-08-01 [1]
- **billystrings2024-07-30G-Man2024-07-30**: taped by G-Man; transferred by G-Man; source: AUD> Audio Technica AT2020> Tascam DR-40X [2]. Also: Listener notes this audience recording was made with a Tascam DR-40X recorder [5]
- **billystrings2024-07-30.Capt.Greg.FLAC**: taped by Capt. Stealth; transferred by Capt. Greg; source: AUD [3]
- **billystrings2024-07-30.fernandez**: taped by Phil Fernandez; transferred by Phil Fernandez; source: CA11s > CA9100 > Roland R-05 [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Furlidays: [Billy Strings At DCU Center In Worcester MA On July 30-31 2024 Poster Canvas](https://furlidays.com/products/billy-strings-at-dcu-center-in-worcester-ma-on-july-30-31-2024-poster-canvas/) [7]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings DCU Center Worcester N1 Poster Regular - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/dcu-center-worcester-n1-poster-regular/) [8]
- Poster by 92.5 the River: [Billy Strings @ DCU Center - 92.5 the River](https://theriverboston.com/events/billy-strings-dcu-center/) [9]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings DCU Center Worcester N1 Poster Regular - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/dcu-center-worcester-n1-poster-regular/) [10]
